snippet.title: Frogging Up - Official Gameplay Trailer | Rage Climbing Game (PS5, PS4, Switch)
snippet.description:
A chaotic rage climbing game where every mistake sends you back 🐸

Frogging Up is a fast-paced platformer focused on precision, timing, and pure frustration in the best way possible.
Climb higher, avoid falling, and try not to lose your progress.

This gameplay trailer shows core mechanics, level design, and the challenge you’ll face on the way up.

🎮 Available now on PlayStation 5 & PlayStation 4
🕹️ Available now on Nintendo Switch
🟢 Coming soon to Xbox

What to expect:
• Precision platforming gameplay
• Rage moments and high-risk jumps
• Simple mechanics, hard mastery
• Addictive “one more try” feeling
